cases.description: All members follow the protocol; R5 is empty and no R6 round exists.
cases.name: rekey_2of3

cases.description: Dealer 3's R4 vector passes only member 1's check; member 2's R5 complaint leads to R6 reconstruction of dealer 3.
cases.name: rekey_2of3_selective_extraction

cases.description: Dealer 5's R4 passes only at members 4 and 5; member 4 files an invalid R5 complaint; members 4 and 5 send no R6.
cases.name: rekey_3of5_two_faulty

cases.description: Dealer 1's bad value to member 2 is answered; dealer 4 sends two R1 messages; dealer 5 does not answer member 1's complaint.
cases.name: rekey_3of5_answers_and_disqualification

cases.description: Only member 1 sends R6 for faulted dealer 3.
cases.name: insufficient_reconstruction_values

cases.description: Dealer 4's R4 passes only its own check; members 1-3 complain in R5; member 4 sends no R6 and members 1-3 reconstruct dealer 4.
cases.name: rekey_3of4_one_faulty

cases.description: F1: a 3-of-3 re-key is outside the genesis fault budget and is refused before any record is read.
cases.name: rekey_3of3_outside_the_genesis_budget

cases.description: F1: a 4-of-5 re-key is outside the genesis fault budget and is refused before any record is read.
cases.name: rekey_4of5_outside_the_genesis_budget

cases.description: F4: the owner-signed statement names a current-certificate digest other than the pinned one; the honest transcript is attached and ignored.
cases.name: rekey_names_another_current_certificate

cases.description: F4: the statement keeps the pinned re-key counter instead of its checked successor.
cases.name: rekey_counter_not_incremented

cases.description: F4: a genesis statement is not a re-key and is refused against a pinned certificate.
cases.name: genesis_statement_presented_as_rekey

cases.description: F6: the honest transcript and statement are checked against a later generation of the same network; the statement names the older certificate.
cases.name: rekey_transcript_under_another_generation

encoding: hex; statements are exact signed bytes; scalars 32-byte big-endian; G2 96-byte compressed
suite: BLS12-381 G2 Pedersen/Feldman GJKR New-DKG; RFC 9180 base mode DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256)/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20-Poly1305 dealings; Ed25519 test signatures
